summary: Candidate A closely implements the frozen contract with a small, focused change. Candidate B directly violates several explicit API, routing, and scope requirements despite offering broader tests and documentation.
reasons: A adds the exact required signature: Upload(ctx context.Context, fileName string, content io.Reader, opts ...FilesOption). B instead introduces UploadFileOption and changes the signature.
A reuses multipartbody.NewFile with field "file" and delegates to FilesService.Add, preserving existing option handling, request construction, decoding, and errors.
A leaves Add and retry infrastructure unchanged. B adds seekable-reader retry machinery and changes body-closing semantics, contrary to the instruction not to refactor request/retry behavior.

B adds association fields, arbitrary multipart fields, several exported option types/functions, and NewFileWithFields, all expressly outside the contract and substantially increasing API surface and maintenance cost.
risks_a: Tests do not cover empty-filename/nil-content validation or source-reader failures.
The retry test only counts requests; it does not compare multipart bodies across attempts or use an os.File/streamed source.
The exported Upload method lacks a Go documentation comment.
risks_b: Upload has the wrong public signature and does not accept the required FilesOption values generally.
Upload duplicates Add's request, response-decoding, and error logic instead of routing through Add.
